aiSummary.text: Oxford offers lower tuition (£25-35K vs A$38-48K) and significantly faster visa processing (3-4 weeks vs 4-8 weeks). However, Melbourne provides more than double the work hours during study (48 vs 20 hrs/week) and a more generous scholarship structure with fee waivers up to 25%. For students prioritizing post-study work opportunities and work-life balance, Melbourne has a clear edge. For academic prestige and European career access, Oxford is the stronger choice.
